title: spec-ticker — a wide fact ticker under a light headline
idea: A light headline with one weighted phrase, over a single rail of real facts running the full width like a departure board. Wide rather than tall, factual rather than persuasive.
why_new: the imageless branch has one register today. The in-flight ledger-hero stacks facts vertically beside the copy; this runs them across the band as one line, which is a different rhythm and a different page height.
built_from: heading plus a flex row of short paragraphs at caption size, full alignment.
risk: only for briefs with real short facts — never invented — and it must wrap to two lines at 390px rather than scroll.
